description_en: Queries the details of screen recording files
description_zh: 查询录屏文件的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-recordings --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token aGN4YzAxQGNuLWhhbmd6aG91LjExNzU5NTMyNjgzMTQ10000 --policy-group-id pg-gx2x1dhsmthe90000 --desktop-id ecd-hlh41mk78dugw0000 --start-time 20230424000000 --end-time 20230424004441 --need-signed-url false --signed-url-expire-minutes 10 --standard-start-time 2025-01-27T02:20:10Z --standard-end-time 2025-01-27T02:30:10Z --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRecordings

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call to this operation. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer ID. If you do not specify this parameter, all cloud computers in the region are queried
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑ID。不指定时，表示查询该地域下所有云电脑
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in UTC+8 in the `YYYYMMDDhhmmss` format
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间。使用UTC+8时间，格式为`YYYYMMDDhhmmss`
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the time in UTC+8 in the `YYYYMMDDhhmmss` format
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间。使用UTC+8时间，格式为`YYYYMMDDhhmmss`
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the URL
parameters.name: need_signed_url

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the returned URL. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 返回URL的有效时间。单位：分钟
parameters.name: signed_url_expire_minutes

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC+0 in the `yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz` format
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为`yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz`
parameters.name: standard_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC+0 in the `yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz` format
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为`yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz`
parameters.name: standard_end_time

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. If NextToken is empty, no more results exist
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个

Recordings.description_en: The collection of cloud computer screen recording information

items.description_en: The cloud computer screen recording information

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the recording. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
EndTime.description_zh:
录制的结束时间。
时间格式为 ISO 8601 标准的 UTC 时间：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

EndUserIds.description_en: The list of end user IDs

RecordingSize.description_en: The size of the recording file. Unit: bytes
RecordingSize.description_zh: 录制文件大小。单位：Byte（字节）

SignedUrl.description_en: The download URL of the screen recording file

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the recording. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
StartTime.description_zh:
录制的开始时间。
时间格式为 ISO 8601 标准的 UTC 时间：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
